description: This file defines the MobileWebReceiver class which manages event handling and communication between native mobile events and a web application interface, including event listeners, message parsing, and event dispatching.

classes.name: MobileWebReceiver
classes.description: A class that listens for native mobile events via window and document message events, parses incoming messages, and triggers corresponding application event handlers.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes event listeners and deinitializes the receiver.

methods.name: listenForNativeMobileEvents
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for message events from window and document.

methods.name: handleNativeMobileWindowMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming message events, parses JSON data, and triggers appropriate application event handlers based on message type.

methods.name: addReactListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for native mobile events and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: handleNativeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches application events based on the ReactNativeToWebEvent received.
